row.title: Karura Forest Adventure & City Views
row.caption: Karura Forest & Nairobi Viewpoints
row.alt: A nature trail in Karura Forest, Nairobi

Categories.value: Karura Forest|Self-published work|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Images from Wiki Loves Earth 2020|Images from Wiki Loves Earth 2020 in Kenya|Images from Wiki Loves Earth missing SDC depicts|Images from Wiki Loves Earth missing SDC location of creation|Uploaded via Campaign:wle-ke

ImageDescription.value:
All images here are of Karura Forest in Nairobi, Kenya. The photos portray a vast forest area comprising of a variety of Plant species- mainly trees like Olea europaea (var. africana), Croton megalocarpus and many more and a lot of grasses and thickets.

The photos also portray the beautiful waterfall within the forest and the nature trail where civilians are allowed to walk through as you'll note- some individuals captured in the photos.

Some of the photos capture the rules put in place by the Forest Management like one to avoid entry towards the Waterfall- which usually gets crowded in a bid to curb the ongoing spread of the highly infectious Corona Virus disease.

The photo gallery size in totality is about 209MBs but each individual photo is just about 4MBs for the smaller sized ones and about 9MBs for the larger sized ones. The photo format for the images is JPG. All images shared here are captured on an iPhone 8 with a 12-megapixel rear-facing camera.

Geographical coordinates for Karura Forest are: DMS 1° 14′ 25″ S, 36° 49′ 25″ E Decimal -1.240278, 36.823611 

Geo URI	geo:-1.240278,36.823611

UTM 37M 257820 9862812

Date photos were taken: 30th July 2019

Artist.value: Eva Ayub
